name: Portfolio Transfer 18
definition: Type of product and assets to be transferred.

MasterReference.name: Master Reference
MasterReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a group of individual transfers as assigned by the instructing party. This identifier links the individual transfers together.

TransferInstructionReference.name: Transfer Instruction Reference
TransferInstructionReference.definition: Identification assigned to the transfer of assets.

TransferCompletionIdentification.name: Transfer Completion Identification
TransferCompletionIdentification.definition: Identification of the completion assigned by the transferor to the transfer.

ActualTransferDate.name: Actual Transfer Date
ActualTransferDate.definition: Date the portfolio transfer instruction was executed.

Portfolio.name: Portfolio
Portfolio.definition: Choice of tax efficient product, general investment or pension.

AllOtherCash.name: All Other Cash
AllOtherCash.definition: Specifies whether all remaining assets in the portfolio not listed for transfer should be liquidated and transferred as cash.

CashAll.name: Cash All
CashAll.definition: Specifies whether all assets in the portfolio should be liquidated and transferred as cash.

ResidualCash.name: Residual Cash
ResidualCash.definition: Specifies how the cash in the account that is awaiting investment is to be dealt with

TaxDate.name: Tax Date
TaxDate.definition: Tax date applicable to all the assets.

PaymentDetails.name: Payment Details
PaymentDetails.definition: Payment process for the transfer of cash from the debtor to the creditor.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information about the product transfer.
